question: I could see fishtownanalytics/dbt:1.0.0 is being deprecated? What is the replacement newer image for the same?
title: Replacement newer image for fishtownanalytics/dbt:1.0.0
answer:
From the documentation of fishtownanalytics/dbt docker page

DEPRECATED Please see GitHub Packages registry for all new images.

The Docker images contained here are for dbt up until 1.0.0 while any newer images can be found at the following locations:

dbt-core: https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/pkgs/container/dbt-core⁠

dbt-bigquery: https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-bigquery/pkgs/container/dbt-bigquery⁠

dbt-postgres: https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/pkgs/container/dbt-postgres⁠

dbt-redshift: https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-redshift/pkgs/container/dbt-redshift⁠

dbt-snowflake: https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-snowflake/pkgs/container/dbt-snowflake⁠

dbt-spark: https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-spark/pkgs/container/dbt-spark⁠

All dbt-labs packages: https://github.com/orgs/dbt-labs/packages?visibility=public⁠
